```{=html}
<!-- Load A-Frame and MindAR via CDN -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.2/dist/mindar-face.prod.js"></script>
<script src="https://aframe.io/releases/1.4.2/aframe.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.2/dist/mindar-face-aframe.prod.js"></script>

<style>
/* ===== AR FILTER PAGE — AT THE BEGINNING ===== */
.ar-page-wrapper {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a0e2e 40%, #2D1B4E 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    color: #F5E6E0;
    padding-bottom: 3rem;
}

.ar-header {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: 600px;
}

.ar-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #C9A87C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.3);
    padding: 0.4rem 1.2rem;
    border-radius: 50px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.ar-header h1 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3rem);
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C9A87C 0%, #F5E6E0 50%, #C9A87C 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-size: 200% auto;
}

.ar-header p {
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.6);
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
}

/* AR Scene container */
.ar-scene-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 640px;
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,124,0.2);
    background: #0A0A0F;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

#ar-scene {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.ar-scene-wrapper a-scene {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
}

/* Start overlay */
#ar-start-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10,10,15,0.95), rgba(45,27,78,0.95));
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.ar-overlay-icon {
    font-size: 3.5rem;
    animation: ar-pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes ar-pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.1); opacity: 1; }
}

#ar-start-overlay h2 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: #F5E6E0;
    margin: 0;
}

#ar-start-overlay p {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.55);
    max-width: 300px;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Buttons */
.ar-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 1.2rem;
    padding: 0 1rem;
}

.ar-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.9rem 2rem;
    border-radius: 50px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    border: none;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
}

.ar-btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7A1B3D, #9B2B55);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(122,27,61,0.4);
}

.ar-btn-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(122,27,61,0.55);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9B2B55, #B53365);
    color: #fff;
}

.ar-btn-secondary {
    background: rgba(201,168,124,0.1);
    color: #C9A87C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.35);
}

.ar-btn-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(201,168,124,0.2);
    border-color: #C9A87C;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    color: #F5E6E0;
}

.ar-btn-ghost {
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.5);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ar-btn-ghost:hover {
    color: #F5E6E0;
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

/* Status bar */
.ar-status {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.5);
    margin-top: 0.8rem;
    min-height: 1.2em;
}

/* Tips */
.ar-tips {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 2rem auto 0;
    padding: 0 1rem;
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
}

.ar-tip {
    background: rgba(45,27,78,0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.08);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.5);
    line-height: 1.5;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.ar-tip strong {
    display: block;
    color: #C9A87C;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* Back link */
.ar-back {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.ar-back a {
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.5);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
}

.ar-back a:hover { color: #C9A87C; }

/* Flash on capture */
@keyframes ar-flash {
    0% { opacity: 0; }
    20% { opacity: 0.7; }
    100% { opacity: 0; }
}
.ar-flash {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: white;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 30;
    animation: ar-flash 0.4s ease-out forwards;
}

/* Hidden canvas for capture */
#ar-snapshot-canvas { display: none; }
</style>

<div class="ar-page-wrapper">

  <div class="ar-header">
    <span class="ar-badge">✦ Expérience Réalité Augmentée</span>
    <h1>Votre moment AT</h1>
    <p>Activez votre caméra et posez avec <em>AT The Beginning</em> — puis capturez le moment.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-scene-wrapper" id="ar-container">

    <!-- Start overlay -->
    <div id="ar-start-overlay">
      <div class="ar-overlay-icon">📸</div>
      <h2>Votre filtre vous attend</h2>
      <p>Autorisez l'accès à votre caméra pour voir le livre flotter à côté de vous.</p>
      <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-primary" id="ar-start-btn" onclick="startAR()">
        <span>✨ Activer la caméra</span>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- MindAR A-Frame Scene -->
    <a-scene id="ar-scene"
      mindar-face="autoStart: false; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no;"
      color-space="sRGB"
      renderer="colorManagement: true;"
      vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
      device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false"
      embedded
      style="display:none;">

      <a-assets>
        <img id="at-cover-tex" src="../images/couvertures/AT_couverture.PNG" crossorigin="anonymous" />
      </a-assets>

      <a-camera active="false" position="0 0 0"></a-camera>

      <!-- Book cover floating to the RIGHT of the face (positive X offset) -->
      <a-entity mindar-face-target="anchorIndex: 454">
        <a-plane
          src="#at-cover-tex"
          position="0 0 0"
          width="0.28"
          height="0.4"
          rotation="0 0 0"
          material="alphaTest: 0.1;">
        </a-plane>
      </a-entity>

      <!-- Subtle glow behind the book -->
      <a-entity mindar-face-target="anchorIndex: 454">
        <a-plane
          color="#7A1B3D"
          position="0 0 -0.01"
          width="0.32"
          height="0.44"
          material="opacity: 0.25; transparent: true; shader: flat;">
        </a-plane>
      </a-entity>

    </a-scene>

    <canvas id="ar-snapshot-canvas"></canvas>
  </div>

  <!-- Controls (hidden until AR starts) -->
  <div class="ar-controls" id="ar-control-bar" style="display:none;">
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-secondary" id="ar-capture-btn" onclick="captureAR()">
      📷 Capturer
    </button>
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-ghost" onclick="stopAR()">
      ✕ Arrêter
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-status" id="ar-status">–</div>

  <div class="ar-tips">
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>📱 Mobile</strong>
      Orientez le téléphone en portrait et éclairez bien votre visage.
    </div>
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>💻 Desktop</strong>
      Placez-vous face à la webcam, à environ 60 cm de distance.
    </div>
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>📸 Capture</strong>
      Cliquez "Capturer" pour télécharger votre photo souvenir !
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-back">
    <a href="./at_the_beginning.html">← Retour à AT The Beginning</a>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var sceneEl = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
  var startOverlay = document.getElementById('ar-start-overlay');
  var controlBar = document.getElementById('ar-control-bar');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('ar-status');
  var arRunning = false;

  window.startAR = function() {
    startOverlay.style.display = 'none';
    sceneEl.style.display = 'block';
    statusEl.textContent = 'Détection du visage en cours…';

    // Wait for scene to init then start mindar
    sceneEl.addEventListener('arReady', function() {
      statusEl.textContent = '✦ Placez votre visage dans le cadre';
      controlBar.style.display = 'flex';
      arRunning = true;
    }, { once: true });

    sceneEl.addEventListener('arError', function() {
      statusEl.textContent = '⚠ Erreur caméra — vérifiez les autorisations.';
      startOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
      sceneEl.style.display = 'none';
    }, { once: true });

    // Trigger MindAR start
    var sys = sceneEl.systems && sceneEl.systems['mindar-face-system'];
    if (sys) {
      sys.start();
    } else {
      sceneEl.addEventListener('loaded', function() {
        var s = sceneEl.systems['mindar-face-system'];
        if (s) s.start();
      }, { once: true });
    }
  };

  window.stopAR = function() {
    var sys = sceneEl.systems && sceneEl.systems['mindar-face-system'];
    if (sys) sys.stop();
    sceneEl.style.display = 'none';
    controlBar.style.display = 'none';
    statusEl.textContent = '–';
    startOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
    arRunning = false;
  };

  window.captureAR = function() {
    var container = document.getElementById('ar-container');

    // Flash effect
    var flash = document.createElement('div');
    flash.className = 'ar-flash';
    container.appendChild(flash);
    setTimeout(function() { flash.remove(); }, 500);

    // Get the renderer canvas from A-Frame
    var rendererCanvas = sceneEl.querySelector('canvas');
    if (!rendererCanvas) {
      statusEl.textContent = '⚠ Impossible de capturer.';
      return;
    }

    // Get the video element 
    var video = document.querySelector('#ar-scene video, .a-canvas ~ video, video[id*="mindar"]')
              || document.querySelector('video');

    var snap = document.getElementById('ar-snapshot-canvas');
    snap.width = rendererCanvas.width;
    snap.height = rendererCanvas.height;
    var ctx = snap.getContext('2d');

    // Draw video frame first (background), then AR overlay
    if (video && video.readyState >= 2) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
      ctx.drawImage(video, -snap.width, 0, snap.width, snap.height);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.drawImage(rendererCanvas, 0, 0, snap.width, snap.height);

    // Download
    snap.toBlob(function(blob) {
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'AT-The-Beginning-filtre.png';
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      statusEl.textContent = '✦ Photo enregistrée !';
      setTimeout(function() {
        statusEl.textContent = '✦ Placez votre visage dans le cadre';
      }, 3000);
    }, 'image/png');
  };
})();
</script>
```
